events.title: Supervisory Data Quality Index for Scheduled Commercial Banks (June 2026)
events.summary: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has released the Supervisory Data Quality Index (sDQI) for SCBs for June 2026 . It measures data quality in terms of the Accuracy, Timeliness, Completeness and Consistency in the submission of returns and microdata for supervisory assessments. The objective of sDQI is to assess the adherence to the principles enunciated in the Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks - Supervisory Returns) Directions, 2026 and Reserve Bank of India (Small Finance Banks - Supervisory Returns) Directions, 2026 . No. Notified Amount (₹ crore) Tenor (day) Window Timing Date of Reversal 1 75,000 1 09:30 AM to 10:00 AM September 24, 2026 (Thursday) 2. The operational guidelines for the auction as given in the Reserve Bank's Press Release 2019-2020/1947 dated February 13, 2020 will remain the same. Ajit Prasad Deputy General Manager (Communications) Press Release: 2026-2027/1168
